name: avantgate
description: Zero-infrastructure, in-process LLM control plane & SaaS observability bridge: real-time cost control, token budgets, PII redaction, prompt guardrails, multi-model failover, durable agent workflow harness, and HTTP telemetry without hosting heavy servers.
author: Antigravity & LexTalk Team

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/finance/index.ts src/agent/index.ts --format cjs --format esm --dts --clean
scripts.test: tsx tests/avantgate.test.ts && tsx tests/financial-normalizer.test.ts && tsx tests/prompt-builder.test.ts && tsx tests/pii-extended.test.ts && npm run test:agent
scripts.test:agent: tsx tests/agent/step-runner.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/isolated-tool.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-patterns.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/storage-adapters.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-aliasing.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-chaining.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/tool-storage.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/telemetry-exporter.test.ts && tsx tests/agent/platform-adapter.test.ts
